learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn about Adverbs, the magical words that tell us How, Where, When, and How Often an action happens!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: These tell us HOW an action is done. They usually end in '-ly'. Example: The cute turtle walked slowly.
These tell us WHERE an action happens. Example: Please come inside the house. The dog ran outside.
Time adverbs tell us WHEN (yesterday, now, later). Frequency adverbs tell us HOW OFTEN (always, never, sometimes).

fun_activity.title: 🎭 Act It Out
fun_activity.instructions: Walk across the room 'slowly'. Now walk 'quickly'. Great job, you just acted out Adverbs of Manner!

quick_recap: ⭐ Adverbs are special words that add more meaning and detail to a verb.
⭐ Adverbs of Manner tell us HOW something happens (loudly, quietly).
⭐ Adverbs of Place, Time, and Frequency tell us where, when, and how often!
